ns2:section.sectionTitle: FE: Where Is the Good Life?
ns2:section.sectionText: Through the study of diverse texts (fiction, film, popular songs, documentaries), students in this course will explore how the concepts of ?the good life? and the ?American dream? are interpreted and fulfilled by different social groups and in different cultural contexts. Students will also get to explore personally, and reflect upon, evolving and persistent inequalities in our own community of C-U, including transportation and housing challenges faced by immigrants or the working poor.
